caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, ornate teapot rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light-colored background. The teapot has a rounded body with decorative, engraved patterns including flourishes and what appears to be a heraldic shield with a crest at its center, surrounded by intricate scrollwork. The lid of the teapot features a fluted design and a knob with additional ornamental detail, and the narrow spout extends to the right. The handle, positioned to the left, is dark and smoothly curved, with a slightly thicker base. Near the bottom right corner of the image, there is a separate circular design, presenting a top view of the teapot's lid, which displays petal-like and rosette motifs around the edge. The artist’s signature, “T. Taylor Braun,” appears to the left of the teapot, near the handle. The drawing is enclosed by a double-line rectangular border.
title: Silver Teapot
